name: WellAlly-health
title_zh: 病历、药盒、症状随口一问就归档的健康助理
tagline_zh: 看病前翻聊天记录找上次的药名？不用了。症状、用药、检查单随手发它，自动归类成时间线，下次问诊直接调给医生看。
tagline_en: Stop digging chat logs for last prescription. Log symptoms, meds, lab reports by chat—auto-filed timeline to show.
desc_en: Ally-Health is an intelligent healthcare assistant that harnesses advanced AI technology and medical expertise to transform personal health management. Through natural language interaction, it helps users record symptoms, manage medications, organize medical records, and access multidisciplinary health insights—making healthcare more intelligent, p
why_zh: 不是问答机器人，是私人健康档案管理员。用自然语言交互降低记录门槛，多学科知识只做辅助解读。
why_en: Not a chatbot—a personal health archivist. Lowers logging friction via chat, uses multi-disciplinary AI only to annotate, keeps.
limit_zh: 只做记录与整理，不替代诊断或急救。需自行对接大模型 API 与数据存储；不支持医保报销、处方开具、危急值实时提醒。
limit_en: Records & organizes only—no diagnosis, no emergency, no Rx. Requires your own LLM API & storage. No insurance, no critical-value alerts. Medical.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Health assistant that files records, meds, symptoms by chat
